ResPointer projects borrowed mutable byte storage plus offset; immutable decoded nodes project mapped resources.

Their earlier80502-case raw witness and CALC-340 behavior remain unchanged. The unchanged ICU78.3 uresbund.cpp public witness passes19888 queries: all982 direct package opens, all996 raw alias occurrences from root/keyTypeData, default/parent/root/direct and fill-in open modes, sticky failures, valid/actual identities, complete content digests, every initialized inline/path byte, long heap paths and the63-byte threshold, source alias-depth boundaries, scalar/iterator/copy state, same-handle/fill-in reuse and retained parent/pool references, plus756 actual ResourceDataValue data/valid-locale context cases. Source-valid narrow/count ranges and the pinned immutable default package are the certified projection; physical allocator/OOM/ABI/freed-pointer states and other packages remain uncertified.
